data.text: I support Kate’s plan: 10 tons each, with catches disclosed every month. Luke, I understand wanting to secure your share, but taking everything destroys your future income along with ours. Ten tons a month earns you $120,000 over a year, and the lake can keep providing after that. My family taught me to fish here; I want our village’s children to have that same chance. Since disclosure afterward won’t save an emptied lake, let’s agree before we launch and check our catches together at the dock. John, will you join us in the equal-share plan?
